paper.title: Superconductivity in the two-dimensional Hubbard model revealed by neural quantum states
paper.authors: Christopher Roth, Ao Chen, Anirvan Sengupta, Antoine Georges

results.system_description: 16x16 square lattice, periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t'/t = -0.2; 224 electrons (112 up, 112 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.source_location: Table V, p. 20 (row t' = -0.2, column Half-filled stripe + SC)
results.eligibility_evidence: Original variational energy of the hidden-fermion Pfaffian state with a group-convolutional neural network (Sec. II B, p. 3). Table V reports competing variational phases on the 16 x 16 cluster; the initialization fields do not enter the target energy.
results.notes: Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it. Audit 2026-10-15: the energy token, original NQS attribution and variational status were checked, but the exact spin-sector assignment in benchmark_id was not independently confirmed from the cited paper. Curator confirmation is still required; this is not a fully verified exact-instance match.
